title: S&P Cotality Case-Shiller Home Price Indices (December 2026 data), 9:00 a.m. ET — the edition that sets the January-2027 print's base
source: EST: the publisher's own standing rule, read verbatim out of three separate S&P Dow Jones Indices press releases fetched direct 2026-09-08 by the case-shiller-hpi-2027-03-30 initial research (the June-2026-data edition at press.spglobal.com/2026-08-25-..., HTTP 200 90,693 bytes; the February-2026-data and January-2026-data editions on the 2026-04-28 slugs, HTTP 200 98,223 and 95,278 bytes): "The S&P Cotality Case-Shiller Indices are published on the last Tuesday of each month at 9:00 am ET." Reproduced by weekday arithmetic — February 2027's Tuesdays are the 2nd, 9th, 16th and 23rd, so 2027-02-23 is the last — and the stated two-month reporting lag puts DECEMBER 2026 data on it. Filed estimate on the same taxonomy count as every S&P DJI entry on this calendar: CONFIRMED_PREFIX in scripts/event-scan-validation.mjs has no member for an index provider's own publication rule, and a discovering lane may not self-confirm. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: DISCOVERED during the case-shiller-hpi-2027-03-30 initial research (2026-09-08, D-568) and load-bearing for it rather than incidental, on exactly the precedent the case-shiller-hpi-2026-10-27 lane set when it proposed its own predecessor edition: the immediately preceding edition is what collapses this print's forecast distance from 2-step to 1-step, and on the measured persistence table that is 0.201pp -> 0.119pp of mean absolute error against a 0.312pp median monthly move (FRED CSUSHPISA, 2015-01 -> 2026-06, n=138). This is the predecessor, not a backfill of the series: the 2027-04-27 successor edition was considered and DECLINED here for that reason. IT ALSO COMPLETES THE TRIPLE ON A DATE THIS CALENDAR ALREADY TRACKS TWICE. 2027-02-23 already carries fhfa-hpi-2027-02-23 (confirmed, 9:00 a.m. ET) and consumer-confidence-2027-02-23 (10:00 a.m. ET) -- the same three publishers, all keyed to the last Tuesday, that the proposer's own research showed have identical release-day sets. Adding this entry is what makes the calendar's own record of that morning honest; leaving it off is what let the chain of FHFA ledgers describe a 9:00 window as single-tenant for seven ledgers running. Impact low and symbols: [] on the measured basis every sibling housing entry records: 0 hits for any housing / house-price / macro keying in docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md or docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md (re-grepped 2026-09-08). An estimate widens caution; nothing here licenses an entry.
